notes: Decision Index 0.3 latency per entrant (latency-v1 protocol, frozen 2026-09-26; index.json 2026-10-06T17:39:21Z). On-card rows: one sequential client, one process, 1 x RTX PRO 6000, model load excluded, the fastest path the model code supports (many entrants ran an author serving stack: see row caveat for latency_path). The Jev reference row is a HOSTED HTTPS ROUND TRIP from the board lab and is stored under separate hosted-rtt metric ids: the board says it is "Not comparable to the on-card single-process figures", so the 2.5x/13x "faster than Jev" ratios computed from 209.3/38.8 vs 524.1 ms mix quantities. Payload size, questions per request and region are not stated per entrant. Cloudflare self-reported 209.3/38.8 ms are in the Cloudflare launch doc; the board measures Clef at 102.1 ms and Clef-flash at 53.4 ms.

claims.statement: On the board latency-v1 measurement Clef is 102.1 ms median (mean 245.5, p95 not recorded) and Clef-flash 53.4 ms (mean 149.8), versus Cloudflare self-reported 209.3 and 38.8 ms for the same models. The board records no latency_path for either Clef row, so its serving stack (hosted or local weights) is unknown. The Jev 524.1 ms is a hosted HTTPS round trip and is not comparable with either.
Perplexity Decider v1.1: 104.1 ms median, p95 835.4 ms, mean 276.9 on the board (on-card).
